author: Claude (claude, handoff 188)
status: FROZEN. Defines what a later shadow, devnet or mainnet stage must record. Recording nothing yet: no stage exists that may produce these fields.
purpose: Fix, before any execution stage exists, exactly what must be measured about it. Written now so the measurement cannot be designed around whatever the first implementation happens to make easy.

the_rule_that_governs_every_field.unknown_is_never_zero: every field below is nullable, and a null means NOT MEASURED. No field may be defaulted to 0, to false, or to an empty list to make a record complete. A record with nulls is honest; a record with invented zeros is not.
the_rule_that_governs_every_field.absence_is_reported: a stage that cannot measure a field records null AND the reason code for why, from `unmeasured_reason_codes`.
the_rule_that_governs_every_field.no_invented_landing_probability: landing probability is NOT a field of this contract and may not be derived from it. A ratio of landed to sent is a description of what happened in a sample, never a probability attached to a future order, and it must not be reported as one.
the_rule_that_governs_every_field.float_forbidden: every duration is an integer count of the stated unit and every amount an integer of lamports. No float appears in a record.

clocks.principle: eight distinct instants, each recorded separately and never inferred from another. A pipeline that stores one timestamp and derives the rest cannot tell where its latency lives.

fields.name: observation_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when the evidence the decision rests on was OBSERVED by us

fields.name: observation_slot
fields.meaning: the slot that evidence describes

fields.name: decision_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when the proposal was decided upon

fields.name: build_started_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when transaction construction began

fields.name: build_completed_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when a signable message existed

fields.name: sign_started_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when signing began

fields.name: sign_completed_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when a signed transaction existed

fields.name: send_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when the transaction left this process

fields.name: receipt_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when the provider acknowledged receipt

fields.name: land_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when the transaction was first observed in a block

fields.name: land_slot
fields.meaning: the slot it landed in

fields.name: finalize_unix_nanos
fields.meaning: when the landing slot reached finalized commitment

fields.name: finalize_slot
fields.meaning: the finalized slot observed at that moment

clocks.derived_durations_are_computed_not_store: any interval is computed from two recorded instants at read time. Storing a duration alongside its endpoints invites the two to disagree.

clock_source_must_be_declared.meaning: which clock produced the unix_nanos values, and whether it is monotonic
clock_source_must_be_declared.why: a wall clock that steps backwards produces negative latencies, and a reader must be able to tell that from a real one

fields.name: priority_fee_microlamports_per_cu
fields.meaning: the compute-unit price actually set on the transaction

fields.name: priority_fee_lamports_paid
fields.meaning: computed from the price and units actually consumed, not from the limit

fields.name: jito_tip_lamports
fields.meaning: null means NO TIP WAS MEASURED, which is different from a tip of zero. A zero must be recorded as 0 only when it is known to be zero.

fields.name: jito_bundle_landed
fields.meaning: tri-state: true, false, or null for not observed

fields.name: ata_rent_lamports
fields.meaning: charged on entry and never refunded; recorded separately because it is not a fee

fields.name: total_execution_cost_lamports
fields.meaning: null unless EVERY component above is known. A partial total is worse than none.

fields.name: quoted_state_slot
fields.meaning: the curve state the decision was priced against

fields.name: executed_state_slot
fields.meaning: the curve state the transaction actually executed against

fields.name: slippage_tokens
fields.meaning: actual minus expected, an exact integer, signed. Null unless both sides are known.

fields.name: slippage_limit_tokens
fields.meaning: the limit the transaction itself enforced, if any

fields.name: partial_fill
fields.meaning: tri-state; this regime's curve does not partially fill, so a true here is a finding

fields.name: outcome
fields.meaning: unknown is a permitted and meaningful value; it may not be replaced by a guess

fields.name: on_chain_error
fields.meaning: the program or runtime error verbatim, never summarised into a category at record time

fields.name: expiry_slot
fields.meaning: the last slot at which the transaction could have landed

fields.name: attempt_index
fields.meaning: 0 for the first attempt; every retry is its OWN record, never an increment on the first

fields.name: retry_of_signature
fields.meaning: links a retry to what it retried, so a chain of attempts can be reconstructed without merging them

fields.name: retry_policy_id
fields.meaning: which frozen policy governed the retry, so behaviour is attributable to a rule rather than to a moment

failure_expiry_and_retry.each_attempt_is_a_record: a retried order produces N records, not one record with a counter. Collapsing them hides the distribution of what it took to land.

fields.name: endpoint_identity
fields.meaning: scheme, host and explicit port ONLY. Never a path, query, fragment or userinfo -- a path credential written into a record is the defect B16/B11 already hit once.

fields.name: provider_region_declared
fields.meaning: as declared by the provider, not inferred from latency

fields.name: leader_at_send_slot
fields.meaning: null unless actually observed; not derived from a schedule that may have changed

must_be_carried_with_every_aggregate: an executed order CHANGED the book, so no observed later price is the price that would have existed without it
a landed order tells you nothing about the orders that did not land, and the two populations differ
competitor reaction is unmeasured and unmeasurable from one's own records alone
a sample of attempts is not a probability of landing, and must not be presented as one
cost measured on landed transactions omits the cost of failures unless failures are recorded with their own costs
counterfactual_limitations.aggregates_require_denominators: any ratio must publish its numerator and denominator as integers beside it, so a reader can see what it is a ratio of.

unmeasured_reason_codes.meaning: the stage does not yet measure this
the provider returned no such field
the field cannot apply to this route or outcome
the value existed and was not captured; a defect, recorded as one
recording it would leak a credential or composition

applies_to_stages.shadow: records every clock and economic field it can WITHOUT signing or sending: observation, decision, and the build/sign/send/receipt/land/finalize fields all null with U_NOT_APPLICABLE. This is what makes a shadow record comparable to a live one rather than a different shape.
applies_to_stages.devnet: may record the full set. Devnet economics are not mainnet economics and every aggregate must say so.
applies_to_stages.mainnet: requires separate explicit authorization that this contract does not grant and cannot grant.

this_contract_authorizes_nothing.statement: freezing what would be measured is not permission to execute. No wallet, key, transaction construction, signing, submission or spending is authorized by this document, and none exists in the repository.
this_contract_authorizes_nothing.phase_gate: PLAN.md Phase 6 requires separate, explicit owner authorization for any live action.
